svg.title: Smart Tutor AI — system architecture
svg.desc: Next.js frontend on Vercel proxies to a FastAPI backend on a scheduled AWS EC2 instance, which uses AWS Bedrock, S3, Postgres, Redis and Neo4j Aura, with Langfuse, PostHog and Prometheus/Grafana for observability and GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
svg.text: Vercel frontend · FastAPI on AWS EC2 · AWS Bedrock · managed data & observability · GitHub Actions
Prometheus remote_write → Grafana Cloud · Alertmanager → Slack
Langfuse v4 traces · PostHog events · container logs → CloudWatch
every PR and every push to main
